plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Gerontology Level 2 (Intermediate) Certificate' program map, Catalog 2025-26, published July 26, 2025 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/6970/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 9.5-13; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end of variable-unit ranges = 3+3+3+0.5 = 9.5 units (WEXP 498 at 0.5 units), verified against the map's 9.5-13 header. This is a Certificate of Achievement (no GE pattern; all courses are major core) completed in one semester. Choice slots: (1) GERON 300 / SOC 335 (Sociology of Aging); (2) GERON 302 / PSYC 374 (Psychology of Aging: Adult Development and Aging). WEXP 498 Work Experience in (Subject): students must be in a paid or unpaid internship, volunteer position, or job related to career goals with a cooperating site supervisor (map note). Certificates of Achievement require a grade of C or better in each major course (map note). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
